source_basis.required_answer_form: целое число или конечная десятичная дробь

global_rules.allowed_characters: digits 0-9, one leading ASCII/Unicode minus, one decimal separator comma or dot
global_rules.spaces: reject; do not silently strip internal or edge spaces
global_rules.empty_state: allowed while editing; not counted as answered
global_rules.partial_state: allowed while editing; not counted as answered until lexically valid
global_rules.paste_behavior: validate pasted text as a whole; do not delete forbidden characters
global_rules.comma_dot_rule: accept comma or dot as web decimal separator after lexical validation
global_rules.minus_rule: accept ASCII hyphen-minus or Unicode mathematical minus only in first position; canonicalize to ASCII minus after validation
global_rules.numeric_equivalence: after lexical validation only, compare finite decimal numeric value; leading zeros and trailing fractional zeros do not change value
global_rules.answered_navigation_state: true only for lexically valid value satisfying mode constraints
global_rules.invalid_input_behavior: preserve typed value, show validation state, do not score and do not mark task answered

number.hint: Введите целое число или конечную десятичную дробь без единиц измерения и пробелов.

probability.hint: Введите вероятность числом от 0 до 1 без единиц измерения и пробелов.

integer_nonnegative.hint: Введите количество точек целым неотрицательным числом.
